priority: Root path-sum weight times current node interval width. Sum all physical parent contributions including late incoming paths to expanded nodes, propagate affected deltas, and use versioned heap. Expose ordinary arithmetic closure, retaining its CPU cost. Treat bulk reducers as opaque physical blocks with original internal task order; zero-weight task dependencies invalidate blocks but carry no physical mass.
certificate_checks: All new full/stop configurations use the same250-unit cadence plus initial, phase boundaries and final extraction. global_both_stop stops at the first actual checked valid certificate; full variants continue to quota, completed work or CPU boundary. No retrospective timestamp truncation. Record first saved certificate and complete settlement cost separately.
fallback: No certificate retains the frozen V45 Markov128 action; a midpoint or a posterior tolerance is not a guarantee. The fallback action is attached for root-level comparison; this stage does not deploy a new online controller.
measurement: One deterministic rotated pass, one process and one BLAS thread, cold solver per call. Complete query cost includes model/history setup, base scoring, solver construction, scores, physical/arithmetic work, queue/weight updates, checkpoint extraction and final frontier summary. Common resident archive load and graph construction are separate. Nested cost timers are labelled and not incorrectly summed. Atomic operations may finish beyond a CPU precheck threshold; report this if it occurs.
validation: Reuse supplied tests and independent full-scan synthetic DAG checks. Verify multi-parent/late-parent propagation, both arms, bulk zero-weight dependencies, pauses, reverse evidence, original entry/ready, destination/scoring separation, valid nested checkpoints and actual early stop before natural calls. Floating zero width/mass alone must not establish complete enumeration while unresolved dependencies remain.
retention: Keep all previous V46/V47 and supplied prototype records; retain all42 new calls including negative, CPU-limited or incomplete cases. No natural reruns or budget extension without a concrete implementation error. Do not rerun the expensive naive global-scan prototype.
scope_and_gate: First establish a strong ordinary bounded evaluator. Certification success is not independent OR novelty or journey-time gain. Inspect remaining-frontier profile before deciding whether dynamic remaining-menu bulk integration is warranted; never reset the original ready time. No automatic72-root online expansion or new dates. Subsequent structure comparisons require the same strong schedule and guarantee.
